image_description: A vintage-style illustration or photograph of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) viewed from a dorsal-top-down perspective. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a reddish-pink to purplish-brown hue and lighter mottling. It has five pairs of legs extending laterally, with the anterior pair modified into large, robust claws (chelipeds). The background is a textured, off-white surface resembling aged paper, with faint, illegible text visible in the upper right corner.
